01An order came all the way from distant Vřesina u Opavy in the Moravian-Silesian Region for the supply of a storage tank for…

An order came all the way from distant Vřesina u Opavy in the Moravian-Silesian Region for the supply of a Roterra 10,000-litre rainwater storage tank, including accessories for watering the garden. This time the installation was handled by the customer and members of his family.

Rainwater is collected from the entire roof of the family house, which has a footprint of 150 m2, and of the barn, which covers 62 m2. Passing through roof debris traps, the water flows via underground KG PVC DN 125 sewer pipes into the underground rainwater tank. The safety overflow from the storage tank is routed into the existing public sewer. Draw-off points for watering are located at several places around the garden and take the form of Pipeline water sockets.

02For this project we handled the entire application for the Dešťovka rainwater subsidy under the Nová zelená úsporám programme, thanks to which…

For this project we handled the entire application for the Dešťovka rainwater subsidy under the Nová zelená úsporám programme, thanks to which we were able to recover a total of CZK 60,500 for the client from the subsidy programme.
